pageDescription: Частные цифровые рабочие пространства для управления активными сделками, аудитами комплексной проверки и задачами закрытия.
dueDiligencePageDescription: Просматривайте пункты аудита, сверенные банковские выписки, сканирование кода и юридические передачи прав на всех ваших сделках.
noDueDiligenceDescription: Чек-листы due diligence появятся здесь, как только одна из ваших сделок достигнет этого этапа.
auditTasksDescription: Комната сделки StackForms · Сверено с Stripe API и реестром юридических лиц Делавэра
institutionalChecklistDescription: Комплексный аудит по финансам, юридическим вопросам, технологиям и операциям
secureVaultDescription: Документы с водяными знаками, доступные исключительно участникам сделки, подписавшим NDA
closingChecklistDescription: Отмечайте условия закрытия и результаты перед окончательным высвобождением средств из эскроу
noTasksDescription: Задачи закрытия появятся здесь, как только они будут добавлены к этой сделке.
noTimelineDescription: Здесь будут отображаться вехи и изменения статуса этой сделки.

flow.cancelDescription: Сделка будет закрыта без возможности восстановления.

stage.initiated: The offer was accepted. Open the NDA to start.
stage.nda: Both parties must sign the non-disclosure agreement (NDA).
stage.dueDiligenceEmpty: Due diligence has started. The buyer should send the list of documents and questions.
stage.dueDiligence: The buyer is checking the business: the seller answers items, the buyer accepts the answers.
stage.dueDiligenceDone: Every item is closed. The buyer can finish due diligence.
stage.agreementNone: A purchase agreement is needed now. Either party creates it.
stage.agreementNoVersion: The agreement exists. Upload the contract file (PDF) or a link.
stage.agreementSign: Both parties must sign the latest version of the agreement.
stage.paymentManual: The agreement is signed. The buyer sends the money and presses “I have paid”.
stage.paymentCard: The agreement is signed. The buyer pays by card.
stage.paymentReview: The buyer marked the payment as sent. An administrator is checking it.
stage.transfer: Payment confirmed. The seller hands the business (access, domains, assets) over to the buyer.
stage.transferReceipt: The seller confirmed the handover. The buyer must confirm receipt.
stage.completed: The deal is complete. The business is sold.
stage.disputed: The deal is disputed. An administrator will resolve it.

waiting.otherNda: the other party must sign the NDA.
waiting.buyerRequests: the buyer must send due diligence requests.
waiting.buyerReview: the buyer must review your answers.
waiting.sellerAnswers: the seller must answer the items.
waiting.buyerCloses: the buyer must finish due diligence.
waiting.otherSignature: the other party must sign the agreement.
waiting.adminConfirms: an administrator must confirm the funds arrived.
waiting.sellerTransfers: the seller must hand the business over.
waiting.buyerReceives: the buyer must confirm receipt of the business.
waiting.adminResolves: an administrator is resolving the dispute.

toast.markedPaid: Payment marked as sent. Waiting for administrator confirmation.

dd.buyerHelp: Request the documents and information you need, accept the answers, then finish due diligence.
dd.sellerHelp: Answer each item in writing and attach a document.
dd.emptyBuyer: Send your first request, e.g. financial statements or legal documents. At least one item is required to finish due diligence.
dd.emptyOther: The buyer hasn't sent any requests yet.

agreement.title: Purchase agreement
agreement.description: Upload the contract; both parties sign the latest version.
agreement.emptyActive: Either party creates the agreement and uploads its file.
agreement.emptyLater: The agreement is drafted after due diligence.
agreement.reviewNotice: This document is not legal advice — have a lawyer review it before signing.
agreement.noVersions: No contract file has been uploaded yet.
agreement.youSigned: You signed. Waiting for the other party's signature.

payment.title: Payment
payment.manualHelp: The buyer pays by bank transfer; an administrator confirms the funds arrived.
payment.stripeHelp: The buyer pays by card through Stripe.
payment.buyerMarked: Buyer marked the payment as sent

transfer.title: Business handover
transfer.description: The seller hands the business over and the buyer confirms receipt.

events.PAYMENT_MARKED_SENT: Buyer marked the payment as sent

form.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 25 MB.
form.ddRequestDescription: Ask the seller for documents or information. Each item is answered separately.
form.answerPlaceholder: Explain, or say that the document is attached
form.answerHint: An answer or a document — at least one is required. The document becomes visible to the buyer.
form.agreementDescription: Name the agreement. You'll upload its file next.
form.versionDescription: Upload the contract PDF or paste a link to it. A new version resets previous signatures.
form.contractUrl: Or a link to the contract
form.urlInvalid: The link must start with https://.
form.versionHint: Both parties sign the latest version.
form.markPaidDescription: Send {{amount}} using the instructions below, then confirm. An administrator will check that the funds arrived.
